why: Un-ships the ruling on #234 (issue #922): an unflagged FFA session's ring and the page's stock strip go back to identity in hue alone, while the flag, its registry text and the developer pane all still say `shape` ships. Every pre-#922 test expected exactly this result, so only the resolver's own table, the loop cases that boot an FFA session, and the page-HUD case can tell. Killed by all three.
killedBy: sessionIdentityMarker: what a session renderer draws (issue #922) draws the shipped `shape` marker in an unflagged FFA session
stripIdentityMarker: what the page HUD draws on FFA entries (issue #922) draws the shipped mark unflagged, none for the reversal value, and a named style as named
startGameWith: dev flags stay off by default the shipped FFA identity marker reaches FFA sessions only (issue #922) draws `shape` in an FFA match started from the Versus Setup pane, with no ?dev

startGameWith: dev flags stay off by default the shipped FFA identity marker reaches FFA sessions only (issue #922) draws `shape` in an FFA session entered by ?dev=1&mode=ffa&players=4, with no identityMarker
createBrowserDeps carries the parsed browser query state into GameDeps hands the page HUD the shipped FFA identity mark, and none for the reversal value (issue #922)
